title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 gives robots a real-time planning and coordination layer
friendlyTitle: Google gives robots a smarter planning system
summary: Google launched Gemini Robotics ER 2, an embodied-reasoning model that watches continuous video, plans multi-step tasks, calls tools and coordinates multiple robots. Developers can access it through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, with an enterprise private preview also available.
friendlySummary: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots understand live video, plan several steps, use tools and work with other robots. Developers can try it through Google’s AI tools now.
whyItMatters: The model separates high-level reasoning from low-level motor control, making it easier to connect natural-language plans to different robot platforms. That could shorten development cycles for warehouses, laboratories, field work and assistive machines while keeping safety checks in the orchestration layer.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make useful robots easier to build for workplaces and public services. One AI system can plan the job while each robot’s own controls handle movement safely.
